Remark
[Remark 5.5]

↗ def:dc-ch1-2-1 ↗ def:dc-ch4-5-1

1. ch4:5.5On a differentiable manifold without a metric, covariant tensors and contravariant tensors, defined using the dual $\mathcal{X}^*(M)$, are distinct. A Riemannian metric associates to each $X\in \mathcal{X}(M)$ a unique $\omega \in \mathcal{X}^*(M)$ given by \[ \omega (Y)=\langle X,Y\rangle ,\quad \text{for all }Y\in \mathcal{X}(M). \] This correspondence identifies covariant and contravariant tensors.
